summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Value ETF (TVAL) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TVAL is an actively managed fund of attractively valued US large-capitalization companies having the potential for stock price appreciation as perceived by the fund adviser TVAL was launched on Jun 14, 2023 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.

holdings.infoBox: TVAL is an equity ETF with a total of 150 individual holdings. The top holdings are Amazon.com stock at 6.34%, Apple at 5.99%, Microsoft at 5.38%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 2.01%, and Johnson & Johnson at 1.90%.
